title: Click RTP Gui
description: Premium click-to-RTP GUI for Paper. Pick a world & region, confirm, and safely teleport thousands of blocks away — with a warmup countdown, cooldowns, and zero unsafe landings.
body:
![click](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6472bddde010f5a04cc5fda5635293131eb9ec92.png)
### Premium Click-to-RTP GUI plugin for Paper *Clean menus. Safe teleports. Zero lag.* ![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.x-brightgreen) ![Paper](https://img.shields.io/badge/Paper-required-blue) ![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-21-orange)
--- ## ✨ Overview **ClickRTP** gives your players a smooth, good-looking random teleport experience through a clean GUI — no messy commands, no lag spikes, no unsafe landings. Built from the ground up for modern **Paper 1.21+** servers. Just run `/rtp`, pick a world, pick a region, confirm, and go. --- ## 🎮 Features - **🖱️ Clean Click GUI** — pick your destination through a polished menu, not a command - **🌍 Multi-World** — Overworld, Nether, and End support out of the box - **📍 Region Selection** — route players to different worlds per region (e.g. Asia / Europe) - **✅ Confirm Screen** — a ✓ / ✗ popup so nobody teleports by accident - **⏳ Warmup Countdown** — on-screen title counts down and **cancels if the player moves** - **🛡️ Safe-Spot Scanning** — async chunk loading finds solid ground; **never** drops players in lava, water, or the void (Nether ceiling-aware) - **⚡ Invincibility on Landing** — brief protection so players aren't ambushed mid-teleport - **🕒 Cooldowns** — configurable per-use cooldown with a bypass permission - **🎨 Fully Customizable** — every message uses **MiniMessage** (hex, gradients, formatting) - **🔊 Sounds & Particles** — premium feel on every teleport --- ## 📜 Commands | Command | Description | |---|---| | `/rtp` | Open the RTP menu | | `/clickrtp reload` | Reload the config | | `/clickrtp rtpdistance set ` | Set the max RTP distance live | *Aliases: `/wild`, `/randomtp`, `/crtp`* --- ## 🔑 Permissions | Permission | Default | Description | |---|---|---| | `clickrtp.use` | `true` | Open and use the RTP menu | | `clickrtp.bypass` | `false` | Skip cooldown & warmup | |
